outlets.name: Fodor's Travel
outlets.credible: Edited destination guidebook publisher since 1936; its Fort Lauderdale/Broward and Everglades restaurant & sight picks are staff-written.

outlets.name: Sarasota Magazine
outlets.credible: Southwest Florida city magazine (est. 1979) with named food writers; its 'Glades Grub' guide covers Everglades City/Chokoloskee eats.

outlets.name: New Times Broward-Palm Beach
outlets.credible: Broward/Palm Beach alt-weekly (sister of Miami New Times) — the editorial of record for Broward restaurants and its Best Of awards.

outlets.name: Florida Rambler
outlets.credible: Long-running Florida travel site by veteran Sun Sentinel/Palm Beach Post journalists Bonnie Gross & David Blasco; fact-based, dated visits.

outlets.name: MICHELIN Green Star
outlets.credible: MICHELIN's sustainability distinction — institutional, awarded only to restaurants already in the guide.
